Container.Name: TrackSeerr-Requests
Container.Overview:
TrackSeerr Requests: the public, stateless request portal. Pair with TrackSeerr Core, which holds your library, Plex token and downloaders.
Requests has no volumes, no Plex token and no download credentials. It signs every call to Core with INTERNAL_CORE_SECRET and can only perform requester actions (discover, request, sign in), so a compromised Requests container can never act as admin. Settings are managed in TrackSeerr Core.
Networking: put this container on the same network as your reverse proxy or cloudflared (e.g. proxynet or a custom bridge), and ALSO on the internal network shared with Core. Cloudflare Tunnel's cloudflared must share a network with Requests, never with Core.
Network setup (one time): 1. In the Unraid terminal run: docker network create --internal trackseerr-internal 2. In Extra Parameters (Advanced view) add BOTH networks, your proxy network first: --network=proxynet --network=trackseerr-internal (replace proxynet with your reverse-proxy/cloudflared network). Unraid ignores the Network Type dropdown once Extra Parameters contain a --network flag; set the dropdown to the same proxy network anyway so the Docker tab shows it. Needs Docker 25+ (Unraid 7); on older versions pick your proxy network in the dropdown, leave Extra Parameters empty, and after each start run: docker network connect trackseerr-internal TrackSeerr-Requests 3. Set TRACKSEERR_CORE_URL to Core's container name on that network (the Docker name of the Core container, default http://TrackSeerr-Core:5251; if you rename Core, change this) and use the same INTERNAL_CORE_SECRET as Core. The network name is your choice; keep it identical on both containers.
If this container refuses to start, check the log: it will not run with a Plex token, Last.fm key, volumes or a missing secret.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Public web port for the request portal. Point your reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel here.

Config.Name: Execution Role
Config.Description: DO NOT CHANGE. This template must run as ROLE=gateway.

Config.Name: Core URL
Config.Description: Internal URL of TrackSeerr Core on the shared internal network (container name, port 5251), e.g. http://TrackSeerr-Core:5251.

Config.Name: Internal Core Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. 32+ characters, identical on TrackSeerr Core. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The PUBLIC URL of this request portal (e.g. https://requests.yourdomain.com).

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs of your reverse proxy or cloudflared (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16). Needed so login throttling sees real client IPs.
